basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I work as a junior data analyst at a local startup. In my spare time, I enjoy exploring new software and playing MMORPGs like Black Desert Mobile. I have a keen interest in fitness and often practice bodyweight exercises. I dislike restrictive internet plans, as they limit my ability to download large game files and software updates. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 6 PM to 10 PM EST. Currently, I'm single and enjoy my independent lifestyle.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Technology, which sparked my interest in data analysis. I am mostly self-taught in data visualization tools and Python programming, often using Reddit communities and online tutorials to enhance my skills.
